consequence.statement: Under the v1beta2 schema, OCIRepository objects (including status writes) that have status.artifact without status.artifact.digest are rejected by validation.
consequence.remediation: Check that OCIRepository status artifacts include a digest. The source-controller normally writes this status field, so this is not usually set by hand.

assertion.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 OCIRepository schema, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, so OCIRepository objects whose status.artifact omits a digest fail schema validation.
